title: Rho split feature
description: Two equal halves: an optional mono eyebrow, a 60px heading whose words rise into place, a calm 20px paragraph and an optional outline button on one side; a near-square dark media panel on the other (either side on desktop, below the text on phones). Text fades up as it arrives.
notes: media: a video or image about 1:1; empty: a dark panel of that shape (it stays dark in light sections, like the original's black video frame)
tone sets dark or light; mediaSide puts the panel left or right on desktop
